title: Object Storage: outage review — application boundary
content:
Object Storage outage review has the following application boundary. This procedure applies to original invoices with an approved US untaxed or verified exempt tax treatment; original tax remains zero. Non-provider causes, zero entitlement and at-or-above-target availability do not create a concession. The latest completed incident is the only incident adjudicated in this request; prior concessions for it remain in the source ledger. The accountant assesses the already completed operational report synchronously; the assessment books no money. For the outage-concession and its original-payment refund procedure, a same-customer same-billing-entity active support contract additionally changes the service-credit amount through its numeric portfolio discount fraction; it does not change approval authority or any primary usage price.

Before assessing the outage concession, the customer claim must be filed.
